name: street-materials-v2

Upper right: refined town-square limestone pavers, small uneven ash-gray cream stone rectangles with worn edges and minute grit, no large checkerboard squares. name: continuous-furniture-v2
prompt: Production fantasy tactical map SPRITE ATLAS exact equal 2 by 2 arrangement, FOUR isolated furniture objects entirely within their quadrants and with generous 18 percent transparent margins around ALL sides. Strictly orthographic directly overhead top-down view, absolutely no front elevation or diagonal perspective. Every object EMPTY with NO dishes, mugs, food, tools, people, lamps, clutter or writing. Upper left: plain long broad rectangular dark honey-brown oak banquet table with finely textured worn wooden planks and carved edge, empty flat tabletop. Upper right: plain sturdy broad long rectangular darker oak tavern counter, thick top and clear stout edge wood finish, empty top, no shelves below. Lower left: long wooden church pew viewed exactly overhead, clear broad sitting bench plus a slim backrest rail along its upper long side, rich aged dark walnut grain. Lower right: long low bookcase seen from exactly overhead, narrow rectangular wooden case with colorful worn book spines inside its horizontal slots, no frontal shelves. Rich hand-painted realistic premium fantasy RPG map materials, restrained natural warm timber, subtle tight contact shadows on actual transparent alpha. Whole isolated objects, no floor, no setting, no text, no checkerboard background. These sprites will be stretched only along their long axis to form continuous furnishing runs; ensure there are no circular or detailed items that would distort.
